source_of_labels: existing frozen analyses and outcomes; no new judgments
public_projection_policy: Only relative source filenames and packet identifiers
No CLI capture, raw provider stream, credential, absolute personal or evidence directory path
Original and diagnostic ordinal tables remain separately auditable

rows.scope: Constructed non-E2E examples; no population H1/H2 inference
rows.recalculation: Count status per variant; verify unique intent_id/constraint_id/replication_id/variant and complete clean/defective pairs.

rows.scope: 18 new minimal-context journeys with LLM ordinal consensus; not strict replication of broad-source pilot and not invented binary-oracle labels.
rows.selected_reference: When you close a task, all incomplete subtasks will be changed to the status "Done."
rows.recalculation: Count severity by arm, preserving browser_status, eligibility and unknown; pair A/C by model and replication.

rows.scope: Retrospective LLM ordinal severity; preserve base and posthoc scope-corrected diagnostic separately.
rows.recalculation: Base and correction: group by case_id/model with A/C. Unknown if either severity null; otherwise compare numeric ordinal ranks. For diagnostic only replace two declared base pair cells using corrected rows for same case/model and verify identical original_html_sha256 per arm. Never overwrite base labels.
